page.overview:
What is Satsuruzo Kingdom?

The Satsuruzo Kingdom is a nation somewhere in the East Blue.

Nothing is currently known about this country's geography because it has yet to make an appearance.

The only known citizen of the Satsuruzo Kingdom is Koby, prior to his kidnapping by the Alvida Pirates.

Two years before the start of the story, Koby set out to go fishing from the Satsuruzo Kingdom. However, he accidentally boarded the Miss Love Duck, and was forced to work as the Alvida Pirates' cabin boy.
